_comment: Gates run as child processes (each test execFileSync's the gate's index.mjs), so the code under test lives in a separate process from the test. Standard in-process coverage instrumentation would read 0% — the command runner is the only correct fit: Stryker mutates the index.mjs ON DISK, then runs `node --test`, whose spawned gate picks up the mutated file. mutate targets only the gate logic, never tests or the shared lib scaffolding (its own suite covers it).
